title: 維多利亞大電池
subcategoryTitleEn: Landmark storage, transmission and hydrogen projects
summary: 澳洲維多利亞州的大電池 300 MW、450 MWh，由 212 部貨櫃大小的電池機櫃組成，2021 年底啟用。它最主要的合約很特別：每年夏天保留 250 MW 不進市場，隨時準備在輸電線跳脫時瞬間放電，讓連接鄰州的聯網線可以多輸入電力。它在試運轉時也發生過一次受到全球關注的火災。課程定量分析保留容量與市場容量的分配、支撐聯網線所需的電量、機櫃的規格、火災中損失的比例、套利的價差與合約的價值。
summaryEn: The Victorian Big Battery in Australia, 300 MW and 450 MWh in 212 container-sized battery cabinets, opened at the end of 2021. Its main contract is unusual: each summer 250 MW is held out of the market, ready to discharge instantly if a transmission line trips, so the interconnector to the neighbouring state can import more. During commissioning it also had a fire watched around the world. The course quantifies the split between reserved and market capacity, energy needed to support the interconnector, cabinet ratings, the share lost in the fire, arbitrage spread and contract value.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：維多利亞大電池
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Victorian Big Battery
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「功率、能量與時長」與「夏季保留容量與市場容量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power, energy and duration" and "Reserved and market capacity in summer": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power, energy and duration" is correct?
options: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。
儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。
電池只能做一件事，不是調頻就是套利。
optionsEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration.
The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating.
A battery can do only one thing, regulation or arbitrage.
quiz.explanation: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「功率、能量與時長」如何決定「維多利亞大電池」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power, energy and duration” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Victorian Big Battery”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：電站的規模為 300 MW、450 MWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: The station is 300 MW and 450 MWh
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「功率、能量與時長」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power, energy and duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 電池儲能系統有兩個獨立的規格：功率（MW）決定瞬間能輸出多少，能量（MWh）決定能持續多久，兩者相除就是放電時長。調頻用的系統時長可能只有半小時到一小時，移轉太陽能尖峰的系統則為四小時或更長。功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
knowledge.textEn: A battery storage system has two independent ratings: power in MW sets how much it can deliver at an instant and energy in MWh how long it lasts, their ratio being discharge duration. Systems for frequency regulation may have half an hour to an hour, while those shifting solar peaks have four hours or more. The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 電站的規模為 300 MW、450 MWh
knowledge.textEn: The station is 300 MW and 450 MWh

quiz.question: 依「功率、能量與時長」的模型 t = E / P，額定功率下的放電時長最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Power, energy and duration", which value is closest to the discharge duration at rated power?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「功率、能量與時長」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power, energy and duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pb 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pb by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.36 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.36 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.50 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pb 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.50 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pb with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 Eb = 450 MWh、Pb = 300 MW，得 1.50 h（額定功率下的放電時長）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with Eb = 450 MWh, Pb = 300 MW the result is 1.50 h (discharge duration at rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pb 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.36 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pb by 10% changes the result to 1.36 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「功率、能量與時長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power, energy and duration"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
電池起火時，用大量的水就能把它撲滅。
依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A battery fire can be put out with plenty of water.

Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.
quiz.explanation: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「功率、能量與時長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power, energy and duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 IEC 62933-2-1 做容量試驗：在規定溫度下以額定功率由滿充放到截止，於併接點量測可用能量，並在壽期內定期重測。
knowledge.textEn: Run a capacity test under IEC 62933-2-1: discharge at rated power from full to cut-off at the specified temperature, measure usable energy at the point of connection, and repeat periodically through life.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要同時載明交流側可用能量、額定功率、量測點與壽期末保證值，避免直流標稱值與交流可用值混淆。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state usable AC energy, rated power, measurement point and end-of-life guarantee together, to avoid confusing nominal DC with usable AC values.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62271 高壓開關設備與控制設備。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62271 High-voltage switchgear and controlgear. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「功率、能量與時長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Power, energy and duration" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
電池只能做一件事，不是調頻就是套利。
optionsEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A battery can do only one thing, regulation or arbitrage.
quiz.explanation: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 功率、能量與時長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power, energy and duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「功率、能量與時長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power, energy and duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「維多利亞大電池」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Victorian Big Battery”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率與能量之比也稱為 C 率：1C 表示一小時放完，0.25C 表示四小時；C 率越高，電芯發熱越多、壽命與效率越低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The power-to-energy ratio is also the C-rate: 1C empties in an hour, 0.25C in four; higher C-rates heat cells more and lower life and efficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲能系統的規模只要看 MW 就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The size of a storage system is fully described by its MW rating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若合約只寫「直流側標稱能量」，扣除轉換損失、輔助用電與不可用的荷電區間後，併接點實際可用能量可能少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: If the contract states only nominal DC energy, usable energy at the point of connection after conversion loss, auxiliaries and unusable state-of-charge range may be more than a tenth lower.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 夏季保留容量與市場容量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Reserved and market capacity in summer: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「夏季保留容量與市場容量」如何決定「維多利亞大電池」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reserved and market capacity in summer” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Victorian Big Battery”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 這座電站並不是整年都在電力市場上自由買賣。每年十一月到隔年三月，是澳洲東南部最熱、用電最高的季節；這段期間它有二百五十 MW 的功率被電網調度機構「包下來」，平時不動，只等事故發生。剩下的五十 MW 才能進市場賺價差與輔助服務的收入。過了夏天，三百 MW 全部回到市場。這種把同一座電池在不同季節賣給不同用途的做法，叫做「價值疊加」；它讓電站的收入不必只靠波動很大的現貨價差。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: This station does not trade freely in the power market all year. November to March is the hottest season of highest demand in south-eastern Australia, and then 250 MW of its power is booked by the grid operator, idle in normal times and waiting for an incident. Only the other 50 MW enters the market for spread and ancillary service income. After summer all 300 MW returns to the market. Selling one battery to different uses in different seasons is called value stacking, and spares the station from living on volatile spot spreads alone. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：由 212 部電池機櫃組成
steps.observationEn: Project file: It consists of 212 battery cabinets
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電池只能做一件事，不是調頻就是套利。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A battery can do only one thing, regulation or arbitrage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「夏季保留容量與市場容量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Reserved and market capacity in summer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

November to March is the hottest season of highest demand in south-eastern Australia, and then 250 MW of its power is booked by the grid operator, idle in normal times and waiting for an incident. Only the other 50 MW enters the market for spread and ancillary service income. After summer all 300 MW returns to the market. quiz.question: 依「夏季保留容量與市場容量」的模型 f = P_r / P，保留 250 MW 相對於額定功率 300 MW 的比例最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model f = P_r / P for "Reserved and market capacity in summer", which value is closest to the 250 MW reserved as a share of 300 MW rated power?
quiz.explanation: f = P_r / P；代入 Pr = 250 MW、P = 300 MW，得 83.3 %（保留 250 MW 相對於額定功率 300 MW 的比例）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: f = P_r / P; with Pr = 250 MW, P = 300 MW the result is 83.3 % (250 MW reserved as a share of 300 MW rated power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 夏季保留容量與市場容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reserved and market capacity in summer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「夏季保留容量與市場容量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Reserved and market capacity in summer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f = P_r / P；代入 Pr = 250 MW、P = 300 MW，得 83.3 %（保留 250 MW 相對於額定功率 300 MW 的比例）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Pr 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f = P_r / P; with Pr = 250 MW, P = 300 MW the result is 83.3 % (250 MW reserved as a share of 300 MW rated power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Pr by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Pr 增加 10% 時，結果變為 91.7 %（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Pr by 10% changes the result to 91.7 % (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 83.3 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Pr 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 83.3 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Pr with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f = P_r / P；代入 Pr = 250 MW、P = 300 MW，得 83.3 %（保留 250 MW 相對於額定功率 300 MW 的比例）。
knowledge.textEn: f = P_r / P; with Pr = 250 MW, P = 300 MW the result is 83.3 % (250 MW reserved as a share of 300 MW rated power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Pr 增加 10% 時，結果變為 91.7 %（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Pr by 10% changes the result to 91.7 % (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「夏季保留容量與市場容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reserved and market capacity in summer"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以調度紀錄確認保留期間的可用功率與荷電狀態符合合約要求，並統計實際被觸發的次數。
電池容量太小，對大電網的頻率穩定沒有實質幫助。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Dispatch records confirm available power and state of charge meet the contract in the reserved season, with actual activations counted.
Batteries are too small to help the frequency stability of a large grid in any real way.
quiz.explanation: 以調度紀錄確認保留期間的可用功率與荷電狀態符合合約要求，並統計實際被觸發的次數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Dispatch records confirm available power and state of charge meet the contract in the reserved season, with actual activations counted. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 夏季保留容量與市場容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reserved and market capacity in summer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「夏季保留容量與市場容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reserved and market capacity in summer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以調度紀錄確認保留期間的可用功率與荷電狀態符合合約要求，並統計實際被觸發的次數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Dispatch records confirm available power and state of charge meet the contract in the reserved season, with actual activations counted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：多重用途的儲能要以控制系統確保各合約的功率與電量互不侵占，並由調度機構即時監視。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use the control system to keep power and energy for each contract from encroaching in multi-use storage, monitored in real time by the operator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保留容量期間若為了市場收益而把電量放低，事故發生時電站無法提供合約承諾的功率與時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Run low for market income in the reserved season, the station cannot give contracted power and duration when an incident comes. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以調度紀錄確認保留期間的可用功率與荷電狀態符合合約要求，並統計實際被觸發的次數。
knowledge.textEn: Dispatch records confirm available power and state of charge meet the contract in the reserved season, with actual activations counted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 多重用途的儲能要以控制系統確保各合約的功率與電量互不侵占，並由調度機構即時監視。
knowledge.textEn: Use the control system to keep power and energy for each contract from encroaching in multi-use storage, monitored in real time by the operator.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60633／IEC 62747 高壓直流輸電術語（LCC 與 VSC）。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60633 / IEC 62747 Terminology for HVDC transmission (LCC and VSC). Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「夏季保留容量與市場容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reserved and market capacity in summer" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
工廠組裝好的設備，到現場不必再檢查。
保留容量期間若為了市場收益而把電量放低，事故發生時電站無法提供合約承諾的功率與時間。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Factory-assembled plant needs no checking on site.
Run low for market income in the reserved season, the station cannot give contracted power and duration when an incident comes.
quiz.explanation: 保留容量期間若為了市場收益而把電量放低，事故發生時電站無法提供合約承諾的功率與時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Run low for market income in the reserved season, the station cannot give contracted power and duration when an incident comes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 夏季保留容量與市場容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reserved and market capacity in summer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「夏季保留容量與市場容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Reserved and market capacity in summer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保留容量期間若為了市場收益而把電量放低，事故發生時電站無法提供合約承諾的功率與時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「維多利亞大電池」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Run low for market income in the reserved season, the station cannot give contracted power and duration when an incident comes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Victorian Big Battery”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種把同一座電池在不同季節賣給不同用途的做法，叫做「價值疊加」；它讓電站的收入不必只靠波動很大的現貨價差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Selling one battery to different uses in different seasons is called value stacking, and spares the station from living on volatile spot spreads alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電池只能做一件事，不是調頻就是套利。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A battery can do only one thing, regulation or arbitrage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保留容量期間若為了市場收益而把電量放低，事故發生時電站無法提供合約承諾的功率與時間。
knowledge.textEn: Run low for market income in the reserved season, the station cannot give contracted power and duration when an incident comes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
